name: Onward Technologies Ltd
title: Onward Technologies Ltd - 517536 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue hit a record INR 151.2 crore (+11.5% YoY, +8.7% QoQ) and EBITDA margin rose 113bp QoQ to 12.3%, but there is no capacity or utilisation disclosure and management reiterated only double-digit growth.

triggers.label: Order book/ACV exceeds last year's revenue
triggers.quote: our order book, or ACV, for this year has crossed last year's revenue

triggers.label: INR 33 crore ODC win from existing client
triggers.quote: The ODC deal that we won this quarter for INR 33 crore is only a starting point.

triggers.label: Customers >$1M rise 16 to 18
triggers.quote: increased the number of customers generating over $1 million in annual revenue from 16 to 18

triggers.label: Fourth design centre in Pune adds capacity
triggers.quote: we decided to open a fourth centre, which is coming up in August

guidance.quote: we are committed and are working very hard to deliver double-digit revenue growth and double-digit EBITDA margin on an annual basis

guidance.value: Double digits, improving QoQ and YoY
guidance.quote: we are confident that it will be in double digits and continue to improve quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year
we do believe we'll continue to be at 80% to 90% time and material at least for this financial year

red_flags.label: Subcontracting costs up 36% YoY (INR 25 cr to INR 34 cr), management attributes to travel constraints
red_flags.quote: subcontracting costs, which have increased by 36% YoY from INR 25 crore to INR 34 crore

red_flags.label: PAT margin not improved YoY; PAT down YoY per management
red_flags.quote: while PAT was lower on a year-on-year basis, sequential performance improved significantly

red_flags.label: Offshore mix moderated this quarter
red_flags.quote: your offshore mix has moderated slightly this quarter

evasions.quote: Several customers will increase onsite, several will increase offshore, and I think it's all about timing.
So, I think you are looking at transactions from a quarterly basis. I'm giving you an annual perspective.
We don't have a particular timeline, its an aspiration to move up the technology value chain.

summary.headline: Onward Technologies posted record Q1 FY27 revenue of INR 151.2 crore (+11.5% YoY, +8.7% QoQ) with EBITDA margin up 113 bps QoQ to 12.3%.
summary.overview: Revenue crossed INR 150 crore for the first time, with EBITDA up 20% QoQ to INR 18.4 crore and PAT up 16.9% QoQ to INR 11.2 crore. Management highlighted an INR 33 crore offshore development centre (ODC) win from a North American power management company and an increase in $1 million-plus customers from 16 to 18. The company completed its first-ever share buyback in the quarter, with promoters not participating. On a YoY basis PAT margin was weaker, which analysts pressed on, and management pointed to sequential gains and reiterated double-digit revenue and EBITDA growth guidance.

financial_highlights.change: +11.5% YoY, +8.7% QoQ; highest ever quarterly revenue
+16.9% QoQ; lower YoY per analyst question
Management aspiration INR 35 lakhs; ~2,500 employees per analyst
+36% YoY from INR 25 crore (as cited by analyst, quarterly)

segments.name: Industrial Equipment & Heavy Machinery
segments.commentary: Oldest vertical, held 15+ years with most engagements 10+ years; expanding from India/GCC into global markets. Management says clients are at record revenues and profits.

segments.name: Healthcare (HCLS)
segments.commentary: No clients have crossed $1 million annual revenue yet; management sees 20% to 50% YoY growth potential, with Q1 described as a very good quarter.

segments.name: Automotive
segments.commentary: Management said spending is selective; positive momentum with a few select customers in specialised areas. Confirmed positive auto growth expected this year when asked directly.

segments.name: Power management / data centre (ODC)
segments.commentary: INR 33 crore ODC win from an existing North American power management customer; centre goes live in August, billing from Q2, full revenue expected in Q3. Initial team about 40 engineers, scaling to 200-500.

guidance_outlook: Management reiterated double-digit revenue growth and double-digit EBITDA growth YoY on an annual basis, with EBITDA margin expected to improve QoQ and YoY.
Order book/ACV for FY27 has already crossed last year's revenue, per management.
Time & material to remain 80% to 90% of revenue at least for FY27; Q1 fixed price share was around 16%, which management called cyclical.
No specific timeline given for revenue per employee rising from INR 22 lakhs toward INR 35 lakhs; described as an aspiration.
Management said there will be no hockey-stick curve in the services business; growth to be sequential and disciplined.
capex_capacity: Chennai digital AI lab is fully operational with a few hundred people; spare capacity expected to fill soon, with bigger Chennai expansion planned later.
Fourth design centre in Pune opening in August 2026, as the three existing Pune offices are fully occupied.

Company is investing upfront in subject matter experts, lab infrastructure, proof-of-concept development, accelerators and reusable IP across three lines of business: mechanical engineering, embedded and digital.

ODC for the INR 33 crore win: about 40 engineers to start, ramping up; work spans mechanical, electrical and electronics engineering; management cited roughly $3 million to $3.5 million of investment from Onward (as framed by analyst).
demand_pricing: Customer spending is selective; demand is strongest for software-defined engineering, AI, automation, cost optimisation and product innovation.
Pipeline described as broader and higher quality than a year ago, with several multi-year RFQs in play; the INR 33 crore win is described as a starting point.
Power management companies focused on data centres are a strong pipeline area; management expects significant scale over at least the next three years.
Customers are moving more work to time & material, which management said increased in Q1 and is expected to continue into Q2.
Top 25 customers contribute 87% of revenue; 73 live customers, of which 70-plus are described as large.

qa_highlights.question: Will auto segment growth be positive this year given mixed industry commentary on European OEMs?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said yes; spending is selective, but positive momentum with a few select customers in areas of specialisation.

qa_highlights.question: Is the revenue per employee target of INR 30-40 lakhs achievable, and when?
qa_highlights.answer: No specific timeline; the aspiration is to move up the value chain. Revenue per employee is INR 22 lakhs today, with INR 35 lakhs targeted via onsite work and higher value.

qa_highlights.question: What EBITDA margin trajectory should be expected and what drives it?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said offshore mix drives margin expansion, as fixed cost per client stays flat while revenue per client grows. Double-digit EBITDA guided, improving QoQ and YoY.

qa_highlights.question: Why did subcontracting costs rise 36% YoY?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the FY26 ratio of subcontracting plus employee cost to revenue fell versus FY25. Short-term local hiring in Europe and US was used because travel was hard amid Middle East conflict; this will be backfilled over the year.

qa_highlights.question: Why did fixed price mix rise to about 16% in Q1?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is cyclical and not a pivot. It expects 80% to 90% time & material for FY27 as customers prefer T&M.

qa_highlights.question: Will PAT margin improve toward 10-12%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management pointed to sequential PAT growth of 16.9% and margin gain of 113 bps, and reiterated double-digit EBITDA margin as the annual goal, without giving a PAT margin target.

risks_watch: YoY PAT was lower despite record revenue; sustained margin expansion still unproven.
Subcontracting cost up 36% YoY (per analyst) and temporary local hiring in Europe and US, which may add cost until backfilled.
Macro uncertainty and Middle East conflict cited as limiting travel and hiring; European auto OEM project cancellations noted in the industry.
Concentration: top 25 customers are 87% of revenue; the ODC ramp depends on Pune centre going live in August and billing starting in Q2.
Q2 time & material momentum and Q3 full-revenue ramp of the INR 33 crore ODC are the key items to track.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on growth, pipeline and client depth, repeatedly reiterating double-digit guidance. Becomes evasive on specifics such as PAT margin targets, revenue-per-employee timing and the YoY profit decline, and falls back on sequential improvement.
key_quotes: We delivered our highest ever quarterly revenue of INR 151.2 crore, crossing the INR 150 crore milestone for the first time, with revenue growing 11.5% year-on-year and 8.7% sequentially.
What's even more exciting for me to share with all of you today is that our order book, or ACV, for this year has crossed last year's revenue.
Do I see there being a hockey -stick curve in my business? No, I don't see that coming.

adds.what: Fourth Pune design centre opening August 2026 (three existing Pune offices fully occupied)
INR 33 crore offshore development centre (ODC) for North American power management customer; ~40 engineers initially, scaling to 200-500

growth.why: Management reiterated double-digit annual revenue and EBITDA growth for FY27 (midpoint 10%), backed by an order book/ACV already above last year's revenue, a INR 33 crore ODC win going live in August, and a fourth Pune centre opening in August; no quantified capacity additions beyond these.
